tag: 客房清潔團隊週末客滿會議

level.why: 先說兩百位房客再更正為兩百六十位，資訊密集，含意圖題與身份題

script.t: Okay, housekeeping team, let's gather round, because we have a very busy weekend ahead.
script.zh: 好，客房清潔團隊，大家聚過來，因為我們有個非常忙碌的週末。

script.t: Earlier this week, I told you that we expect two hundred guests on Saturday.
script.zh: 本週稍早我告訴過大家，週六預計有兩百位房客。

script.t: The front office just updated that number, and it is now two hundred and sixty.
script.zh: 櫃檯剛更新了數字，現在是兩百六十位。

script.t: The increase comes from a large tour group that arrives on Saturday afternoon.
script.zh: 增加的原因是有一個大型旅行團會在週六下午抵達。

script.t: That means every room must be ready by two o'clock, not four, as usual.
script.zh: 這表示每間房必須在兩點前準備好，而不是像往常的四點。

script.t: I know that is a tight schedule, but I trust you to manage it.
script.zh: 我知道時程很緊，但我相信你們能應付。

script.t: To help, I have asked the laundry service to bring extra linens on Friday evening.
script.zh: 為了幫忙，我已請洗衣服務在週五晚上多送一些床單織品。

script.t: Each of you will clean fourteen rooms instead of twelve.
script.zh: 你們每人要清潔十四間房，而不是十二間。

script.t: Floor supervisors will check the rooms before they are marked ready.
script.zh: 樓層主管會在房間被標示為完成前進行檢查。

script.t: Anyone who needs extra supplies should ask Carlos at the supply closet.
script.zh: 需要額外用品的人，請到備品室找卡洛斯。

script.t: If you run into any problems, text me right away.
script.zh: 如果遇到任何問題，請立刻傳訊息給我。

script.t: Thanks for your hard work, and let's make this a great weekend.
script.zh: 謝謝大家的辛勞，讓我們一起度過美好的週末。

choices.why: 她開頭就稱呼 housekeeping team。
櫃檯只是更新人數的單位。
洗衣服務只是被請求配合的對象。
旅行團只是增加房客的原因。

q.t: How many guests are now expected on Saturday?
q.zh: 現在預計週六有多少位房客？

choices.why: 更新後的數字是兩百六十。
這是先前告知的舊數字。
十四是每人要清潔的房間數。
十二是原本每人清潔的房間數。

q.t: What does the speaker mean when she says, "I know that is a tight schedule, but I trust you to manage it"?
q.zh: 說話者說「I know that is a tight schedule, but I trust you to manage it」是什麼意思？

choices.t: She believes the team can finish on time.
choices.zh: 她相信團隊能準時完成。
choices.why: 她承認時程緊，但表示信任團隊能應付。

choices.t: She plans to move the deadline back.
choices.why: 她沒有放寬兩點的期限。

choices.t: She thinks the team is working too slowly.
choices.why: 她表達的是信任，不是責備。

choices.t: She is sorry about the extra linens.
choices.zh: 她為額外的床單織品道歉。
choices.why: 床單織品是她安排來幫忙的措施。

tag: 換屋頂報價比較廣播節目

level.why: 先說網站報價再更正，需結合圖表與年長者折扣計算，含推論題

script.t: Welcome back to Home Hour on Radio 1060, where we help you take care of the place you live in.
script.zh: 歡迎回到1060電台的《居家時間》，我們幫您照顧您居住的地方。

script.t: Today's topic is replacing an old roof before the rainy season.
script.zh: 今天的主題是在雨季前更換舊屋頂。

script.t: I have been looking at quotes from three local companies, and the details are shown on our website.
script.zh: 我一直在看三家本地公司的報價，詳細內容在我們網站上。

script.t: The website lists Pinnacle Roofing at sixty-five hundred dollars for an asphalt roof.
script.zh: 網站上列出尖峰屋頂公司的瀝青屋頂報價是六千五百美元。

script.t: However, Pinnacle called this morning to say that the price is now seventy-two hundred because of higher material costs.
script.zh: 然而，尖峰今早來電表示，因材料成本上漲，價格現在是七千兩百美元。

script.t: Their offer for homeowners over sixty-five is ten percent off the new price.
script.zh: 他們給六十五歲以上屋主的優惠是新價格打九折。

script.t: Summit Roofing is the most expensive of the three, but its metal roofs can last fifty years.
script.zh: 高峰屋頂公司是三家中最貴的，但它的金屬屋頂可以用五十年。

script.t: Coastal Roofing has the lowest price, but it cannot start work until July.
script.zh: 海岸屋頂公司價格最低，但要到七月才能開工。

script.t: Whichever company you pick, ask for a written contract before the work begins.
script.zh: 不論選哪一家，開工前請要求書面合約。

script.t: It is also smart to take photos of the roof before and after the job.
script.zh: 在工作前後替屋頂拍照也是明智之舉。

script.t: Next week, we will talk about fixing damp walls, so send me your questions through our website.
script.zh: 下週我們要談如何處理潮濕的牆面，請透過網站把問題寄給我。

script.t: This is Home Hour, and we'll be right back after these messages.
script.zh: 這裡是《居家時間》，廣告後馬上回來。

q.t: Look at the graphic. How much will a 70-year-old homeowner pay for a roof from Pinnacle?
q.zh: 請看圖表。一位70歲的屋主向尖峰公司購買屋頂要付多少錢？

choices.why: 新價格7,200美元打九折。
以網站舊價6,500美元打九折計算。
這是新價格，漏掉年長者九折。
這是網站上的舊報價。

q.t: How long can Summit Roofing's metal roofs last?
q.zh: 高峰屋頂公司的金屬屋頂可以用多久？

choices.why: can last fifty years。
十是年長者折扣的百分比。
六十五是享折扣的年齡門檻。
七月是海岸公司最早的開工月份。

q.t: What can be inferred about Coastal Roofing?
q.zh: 關於海岸屋頂公司，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: It may not suit someone who needs a fast repair.
choices.zh: 它可能不適合需要快速修繕的人。
choices.why: 最便宜，但要到七月才能開工。
金屬屋頂是高峰公司的產品。

choices.t: It is more expensive than Summit.
choices.why: 海岸價格最低。

choices.t: It is the best company for older homeowners.
choices.zh: 它是最適合年長屋主的公司。
choices.why: 年長者折扣是尖峰公司的優惠。
